# Marked

Version: 15.0.12 (same installed version as this Hexo site).
Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v15.0.12
Browser bundle: marked.min.js, copied unchanged from the installed package.
License: MIT; see marked.LICENSE.md. The copyright header is preserved.

The AI window uses the lexer only. Rendering builds a limited set of DOM elements; it does not insert model HTML.
